title: Privacy Notice
intro: A short summary of how CosmicTrack handles your email, account, and journey data. This notice is written for the friend beta and is not legal advice.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.item1: Email address (required for register, login, and account recovery).
collect.item2: Password (we do not store it in plain text; it is held securely by our auth provider).
collect.item3: Basic profile data you provide (e.g. display name, avatar — if any).
collect.item4: Content you create in the app (journeys, steps, card picks, notes, categories, favorites).

why.title: Why we collect it
why.item1: Authenticate you and secure your account.
why.item2: Sync your journeys and categories across devices.
why.item3: Send essential account emails (confirmation, password reset, security).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.item1: We use strictly necessary / essential cookies to keep you signed in (Supabase auth session).
cookies.item2: We do not currently use advertising, analytics, or marketing cookies, so we do not show a cookie-consent banner.
cookies.item3: If we add analytics later, we will update this notice and ask for consent when required.

processors.title: Where data is stored
processors.item1: Authentication and database: Supabase (your account and journey data live there).
processors.item2: App hosting: Netlify (serves the website; your account database is not stored on Netlify).
processors.item3: These providers are needed to run the service; we do not sell your email for marketing.

ai.title: AI and card meanings
ai.item1: In this beta, “Ask AI” is off; card meanings are filled from CosmicTrack’s deck texts (local meaning files).
ai.item2: When AI is enabled, we will update this notice with what is sent where; we do not currently send personal content to AI.

dosAndDonts.title: What we do
dosAndDonts.item1: No selling or sharing emails with third parties for marketing.
dosAndDonts.item2: No marketing emails without your explicit opt-in.
dosAndDonts.item3: We only process what is needed to run your account and the app.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.item1: Delete your account in Profile; your journeys, steps, categories, and login are removed from our systems.
choices.item2: Update your journeys and account info anytime in the app.
choices.item3: We keep data while your account exists; after deletion it is cleared within a reasonable time (short delay in backups is possible).
